title: FIPS Must Use a Supported Subpolicy
justification: FIPS must be enabled at install time. Red Hat tooling reports that 'update-crypto-policies --set FIPS' is not sufficient for FIPS compliance, and fips-mode-setup is deprecated on RHEL 9 for converting an existing system. SSH cipher and MAC findings are downstream of the crypto policy.
compensating_control: System-wide crypto policy at DEFAULT; SSH key-based authentication only; host reachable from a single administrative CIDR.
milestone: Enable fips=1 in the image build (kickstart)
